newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Athletics-Portugal's Ribeiro to run in Dublin.
newsitem.headline: Athletics-Portugal's Ribeiro to run in Dublin.

text.p: Portugal's Olympic women's 10,000 metres champion Fernando Ribeiro will compete in the European Cup first league final at Morton Stadium, Dublin, in June, the Athletics Board of Ireland said on Wednesday.

Ribeiro will head a star-studded field for the final that will also see Sweden's Olympic 100 metres hurdle champion, Ludmila Enquist, and Finland's Olympic discus champion, Heli Rantanen, represent their national teams.
This will be the first time that the European Cup first league final will be staged in Dublin.
